explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/459: f(u) is the smallest v > u all of whose prime factors divide u (the page's equivalent definition); 'Estimate f(u)'. The page records the trivial bounds u + 2 ≤ f(u) ≤ u², both attained infinitely often, and marks the problem solved since Cambie's observations settle the obvious questions. The statement asserts these bounds for u ≥ 2. As a formalisation of an open-ended 'estimate' it records what the page considers the resolution. Faithful.
